prs.title: fix(pool): shutdown disconnected workers even when `testTimeout` is disabled
prs.author: AriPerkkio
prs.body:
Related to https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11915 but does not close it.

We already have some logic to exit forks when main process suddenly terminates. The handler below triggers only when test runner finishes running a test and is about to send update to main process.

packages/vitest/src/runtime/workers/init-forks.ts#L29

packages/vitest/src/runtime/workers/init-forks.ts#L55-L61

But if user has disabled test timeout and a test case never finishes, runner never sends update to main thread. We'll now listen for `disconnect` event and exit the runner.

prs.title: perf: send source maps to workers as a string
prs.author: maschwenk
prs.body:
Fixes #11717

The fetch result now has the source map as a JSON string in `sourceMap` instead of a base64 comment at the end of `code`, so v8 only compiles the code. The map is stringified once per transform and parsed only when a stack trace needs it.

- The fs module cache and forks pool tmp files store the map after a `\n//# vitestSourceMap=` separator, and the cache version is bumped. On a cache hit the server parses it into `transformResult.map`.
- `getModuleSourceMapById` in vitest's `EvaluatedModules` reads `meta.sourceMap` and falls back to the comment, so stack traces and inline snapshots map as before, in vm pools and watch mode too.
- The custom environment loader uses vite's own evaluator, so it puts the comment back for its few modules.

It's the default, not an `experimental.stripSourceMapComments` option, because a debugger is the only thing I found that reads the comment from the compiled script. For `vm` scripts node's `--enable-source-maps` and `NODE_V8_COVERAGE` ignore it (node 22.22, 24.22 and 26.5: no `findSourceMap` result and no `source-map-cache` entry in the coverage file, with or without the comment). `coverage-v8` reads `transformResult` on the server and istanbul instruments during transform.

So the worker adds the comment back when an inspector is open in the worker or in the main process. A debugger on the main process can attach to worker threads, where `inspector.url()` is undefined, so that state goes to workers as `config.inspector.openInMai

prs.title: fix(cache): allow cache hits in configureServer
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
`FileSystemModuleCache.watchFile` (added in #11860) reads `vitest.vite.config`, but `vitest.vite` is not set while plugins run `configureServer`. A module imported there from the fs module cache, for example with `server.environments.ssr.runner.import()`, failed with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'config')`. Vitest only listens to the watcher of the root server, so the file is not watched until that server is attached.

`ssr-runner.test.ts` passed in CI because the cache starts empty there. The new test runs the same project twice to hit the cache.

prs.title: fix: sort test files before the seeded shuffle
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Fixes #11340

`RandomSequencer` shuffled the files in the order that the glob returned them, and that order can change between runs. The files are now sorted by project name, module id and pool before the shuffle, so the seed alone decides the order.

For most file sets, the same seed now gives a different order than before.

prs.title: fix(vitest): allow assigning to import.meta.env
prs.author: aliamanatali
prs.body:
The meta env replacer rewrote every `import.meta.env` into an `Object.assign(...)` call, including when it was the left side of an assignment. `import.meta.env = import.meta.env || {}` then became `Object.assign(...) = ...`, which fails to parse.

Skip the rewrite when `import.meta.env` is followed by an assignment operator. Reads and property writes are still rewritten.

Fixes #10091
